# Muu – Igoumenitsa, Platanias

> Building Plot in the Harbor of Plataria – Exclusive Location on Greece’s Northwest Coast The charming fishing village of Plataria, situated on Greece’s northwest coast, captivates visitors with its unspoiled beauty, Mediterranean flair, and unique natural surroundings.

- Druh nabídky: myynti

- Cena: 150 000 €
